points.name: ui.object.class_allocate
points.evidence: The implementation walks the class inheritance chain to find instance size, allocates an object, stores class and parent and links it as a child or screen; firmware logs identify lv_obj_class_create_obj. Callers such as the label constructor then separately invoke 0x1c029074 to initialize the object.

points.name: ui.object.event_add
points.evidence: The entry prepares the object event list and forwards object event list, callback, filter and user data to 0x002bfc24. That routine allocates a descriptor, stores callback, user data and filter, inserts it and returns the descriptor.

points.name: ui.object.event_remove
points.evidence: The function iterates an object event list, compares each descriptor callback pointer to argument 1, removes the first match and returns 1; it returns 0 if none is removed.

scope: all calls passing through each shared entry
limitations: A class-allocate return is not yet initialized; replacing it with NULL or an incompatible object can break callers that initialize unconditionally. Event callback and user-data addresses must remain valid for the registered lifetime. Suppressing or substituting event registration/removal changes event delivery and lifetime. Shared-entry publication and rollback require system-wide quiescence, which is not yet established. No device validation.
validation: Exact AP mapping, entry and veneer bytes plus static call-chain analysis; core relocation-plan tests. Full firmware execution and device testing pending.
